command: tmp_user=$(mktemp -d) && tmp_out=$(mktemp -d) && blender --command extension build --source-dir . --output-filepath "$tmp_out/city_modeler.zip" && BLENDER_USER_RESOURCES="$tmp_user" blender --command extension install-file --repo user_default --enable "$tmp_out/city_modeler.zip" && BLENDER_USER_RESOURCES="$tmp_user" blender --background --python scripts/headless/semantic_hierarchy_baseline.py -- --output-dir "$tmp_out"
description: Ticket 01 baseline for the Building-only Railway LoD3 CityGML 2 and CityGML 3 fixtures. Counts are XML ElementTree element counts, not regex matches. The harness builds and installs this working copy as a Blender extension into an isolated BLENDER_USER_RESOURCES directory, then verifies the loaded add-on module path before importing and exporting.
